character.name: Weird Al Yankovic
character.description: Curly-haired musical parodist in a Hawaiian shirt, known for accordion polkas, Eat It and Amish Paradise. Cheerful theatrical energy. Approved visual reference: Polka Pressure, a detailed red accordion with ivory keys and expanding pleated bellows, two rhythmic squeezes then a large curved chord wave with tumbling musical notes. Preserve this as the neutral design. Other specials should have comparable spectacle, staging and character identity, with a usable recovery and distinct down move.
